identity.name: BingX Silicon Motion Technology Corporation (ADR) Perp

about.description: SIMO is a single-stock perpetual listed on BingX, tracking Silicon Motion Technology Corporation (ADR), margined and cash-settled in USDT. Traders get synthetic price exposure only — no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 8h. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
